content: Math Academy: 30-45 min adaptive diagnostic; per-student knowledge graph coloured by stability (darker = more stable); algorithm unlocks a small set of tasks the student picks from; XP ~ 1 minute of focused effort, adjustable daily XP goal; missed quiz topics immediately become review tasks; remediation escalates (more questions, switch topics, remedial review of distant prerequisites); weekly leagues. Anki stats: Today, Future Due, Calendar heatmap, Reviews, Card Counts, Review Time, Intervals, Ease, Hourly, Answer Buttons, True Retention table; FSRS-only: Stability, Difficulty, Retrievability; desired vs true retention vs average retrievability; 'estimated knowledge' = cards reviewed x avg retrievability. Anki review is Space then 1-4, keyboard-first. Duolingo: 7-day streak users 2.4x likelier to return; making streaks easier (decoupled from daily XP goal, freezes) raised engagement; progressive reminder intensity. Khan Academy: weekly streak (level up one skill per week), mastery card, daily/weekly missions. Quantum Country/Orbit: reviews delivered by email/web, embedded prompts, research platform. Brilliant: streaks, badges, daily challenges.
